title: The Voice tip shows once per browser, in one place
steps: S1: Run the voice-mode e2e of tracy-chat-input: the note on a new chat's chat box, a reload, a fresh browser pressing the note, a fresh browser reloading untouched then opening a chat with a header, and the header note with its Chat/Voice menu.
expect: S1: the note shows the first time; after it was on screen once no note shows again in that browser, after a reload or in the header place; pressing it goes into Voice; opening the Chat/Voice menu closes it.
evidence: 21/10/2026 cowork.tracy.site: the note covered the conversation tabs on every load, over the chat box and under the header
fence: The VoiceTip show-once state in VoiceMode.tsx measured in Chromium with real localStorage
